title: PreCompact safety valve: fail open on reactive-recovery block loops
description:
Fixes the latent risk that blocking PreCompact unconditionally in ANTI_COMPACT_ENABLE=1 mode can hard-crash a turn if the block ever lands on a reactive-recovery auto-compact (recovering from a context-limit error the API already returned) instead of a proactive one. The PreCompact payload has no field distinguishing the two cases.

Fix: hooks/lib/state.mjs tracks consecutive PreCompact blocks per session against a non-growing transcript (msgChars). After 3 consecutive blocks with no progress, or an estimated usage >=95%, the hook fails open (exit 0 instead of 2) with a visible '⚠ safety valve' banner instead of risking a silent crash. Opt out via ANTI_COMPACT_SAFETY_VALVE=0.

Implemented via strict TDD: tests/unit/state.test.mjs (new) and tests/integration/precompact-hook.test.mjs (extended) written and confirmed red before hooks/lib/state.mjs and hooks/precompact-handoff.mjs were implemented. Full suite green (68/68).

Docs updated: docs/how-it-works.md (Safety valve subsection under Limitations), docs/_backlog.md (resolved the reactive-recovery half of the autonomy question, left the session-relay half open with a pointer to cc-vscode-ext).
notes:
Implemented and merged via feat/precompact-safety-valve branch; safety valve logic, unit + integration tests all green (68/68).
Merged: https://github.com/joeblackwaslike/anti-compact/pull/1 (squash, commit 8c3fc15). Both anthropicreviewbot and codexreviewbot errored out on API credits (known non-blocker); local ai-review watch substitute unavailable in this session (missing GITHUB_APP_ID/GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY). Sourcery + Greptile reviews both passed clean after addressing Sourcery's two substantive comments with real fixes (unknown-session_id state-tracking skip, readState sanitization test).

title: Autonomous session-relay for unattended agents lives in cc-vscode-ext, not here
description:
The precompact safety valve (see precompact-safety-valve-91n) only prevents the reactive-recovery hard-crash — it does NOT solve the underlying problem that an autonomous/unattended agent has no human present to paste the /handoff prompt into a fresh session when context fills up.

The real fix (SessionRelayManager) is being designed/built in the cc-vscode-ext repo, which already owns the primitives it needs: it drives claude via --input-format/--output-format stream-json, already polls exact get_context_usage after every turn (MessageBroker.refreshContextUsage), can spawn multiple concurrent session processes (ClaudeProcessManager), and already has sendUserMessage() for injecting a message into a running process's stdin.

See that repo's own docs/session-relay-design.md and its own beads issue tracker for the actual design and tracking — this issue exists only so bd prime/bd ready in future anti-compact sessions keeps surfacing that the deeper problem is NOT solved by this repo's fix. Do not close this issue from anti-compact; it isn't this repo's job to solve or to mark done.
